contents.text: {"reason": "The user said 'Hello' and the agent replied with a greeting ('Good evening, and welcome'), introduced itself, and offered a way forward: an Offer card set with three choices (tell about your business, see a demo, show me around the page) and a question asking what kind of business they run.
